## What & why

Briefly describe the change and the motivation. Link any related issue
(e.g. `Closes #123`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy app` passes
- [ ] `pytest --cov=app` passes (coverage ≥ 85%)
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
- [ ] Updated docs if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets or real API keys committed
